name: Special City Council and Planning Commission Joint Meeting
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council and Planning Commission Joint Meeting
AGENDA
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 30, 2014 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
City Council: Council Members Teresa Arballo Barth, Mark Muir, Lisa Shaffer, Deputy Mayor Tony Kranz, Mayor Kristin Gaspar
Planning Commission: Commissioners Anthony Brandenburg, Ruben Dario Flores, JoAnn Shannon, Vice Chair Michael Glenn O'Grady, Chair Kurt Groseclose
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
AGENDA ITEM
1.
A joint meeting of the City Council (Council) and the Planning Commission (Commission) to provide a: 1) Discussion regarding the role of the Planning Commission including but not limited to policies, procedures, expectations and work plans; and 2) An overview and discussion of the presentation materials that will be utilized during upcoming public engagement events on the Housing Element Update. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
1) Conduct a joint meeting to discuss the issues surrounding the functioning of the Commission; 2) Receive an overview of the Housing Element Update presentation materials; and 3) Direct Commission and/or staff as appropriate.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
